primitive_definitions.A: A[dst,src]=1 for inherited coalesced prepared src->dst edges; binary fixed support
primitive_definitions.degree: row count including existing diagonal; strictly positive; no clamp
primitive_definitions.P: P(Z)=(A@Z)/degree[:,None]; identical fixed operator in every role/block/route and native decoder
primitive_definitions.softmax_rows: operation softmax of each node row, temperature1; order PP/PT/TP/TT
primitive_definitions.support_example: 530417 entries including exactly34493 diagonal entries; preparation removes prior loops/undirected coalesces then separately adds one loop per node; continuation adds no further loops

source.frozen: one acquired ordinary U0 aggregate(Fxd), V0 skip(Fxd), b0(d), all frozen
source.H0: ReLU(C(P(X@U0)+X@V0+b0)); undropped raw native X; source eval cache/no_grad
source.live: one U1(d x K),V1(d x K),b1(K) copied from selected ordinary source, common physical parameters across all routes
source.native_order: clip then ReLU in stem; clip logits with no output ReLU in decoder

block.map_ownership: roles and blocks independently parameterized; each same physical role W/b shared across all4 routes
block.T[l,j](Z): C(ReLU(Z@W[l,j]+b[l,j])); ReLU then clip; both return values retained
block.gate_ownership: one gate per block; both maps and both biases physically common to all4 routes; separate between blocks
block.e: private learned e[m,l] shape4 for m0..3/l1,2;32 total; only private parameter coordinates
block.gradient_and_state_scope: P/contexts/all blocks remain differentiated; no detach; shared reused bank retains autograd; each forward resets from H0; private states are activations, not across-step memory
block.no_extra_operations: no intermediate dropout/hard routing/learned graph/feature union/normalization/residual; evaluate all4 operations

initialization.e: onehot(m,4)-0.25 in both blocks; route preference PP/PT/TP/TT fixed label-free
initialization.RNG: shared slow draws isolated from native persistent dropout streams; exact seeds future bindings
initialization.gradient_delay: zero Wo delays all upstream memory gradients on first update; zero G2 separately delays G1 until G2 changes; head/Wo may update immediately

head.D_train: one per-route independent Bernoulli(0.6) element mask; D=Hprime*mask/0.6; own persistent stream; same D feeds aggregate and skip
head.L[m]: C(P(D@U1)+D@V1+b1); native clipped logits with no output ReLU
head.ownership: U1,V1,b1,Wo common physical objects; no private class heads/biases

objective_and_serving.regularization: one constant frozen ordinary first-layer penalty; no added continuation/gate/e/readout/head regularizer
objective_and_serving.serve: mean_m softmax(L[m]) from selected/restored dropout-off forward; never mean logits
objective_and_serving.initial_function: selected ordinary source eval in exact arithmetic at zero Wo; not bitwise certification/later retention
objective_and_serving.no_auxiliaries: no pooled CE, diversity reward, auxiliary labels/errors, private class assignments or cross-route exchange

controls.head_only: same source/cache/live decoder; Hprime_m=H0;4 own persistent TRAIN dropout losses; same eval probability mean
controls.mixed_single: one state, complete same2 blocks/F/context/g, zero Wo and native source decoder; remove route e, ordinary final gate biases trainable;4 TRAIN tail-dropout draws of one state averaged CEs; eval one prediction; source penalty once
controls.equipped_I4: 4 independently acquired/fitted/selected complete mixed-single bodies, each own source/cache/maps/gates/head/Wo/optimizer/RNG/stop; each has single4-draw TRAIN law; total16 TRAIN tail draws/four eval predictions; no coupled selector; charge extra source costs
controls.middle_state_mean: only replace block2 input of every route by mean_m H[m,1]; keep private block2 e, common block2 gates/maps,4 final predictions/ownCE; mean differentiated; never mean final states
controls.middle_scope: same parameters/source/initial draw law/decoder; changes private history, backward coupling and possible block2 computation reuse
controls.original_boundaries: keep competent ordinary/factorized/original-GNNM anchors where applicable; no weak one-expert substitute

inventory.excluded: native source/tail P/projections, source acquisition/storage, backward, sparse preparation, clipping, caches, optimizer, SELECT, restore, CAL; algebra only, no measured savings

failure_logic.utility: unsupported without declared net served improvement versus capable single/equipped I4 and acceptable competence/proper-loss protection
failure_logic.continuation: unsupported without declared paired net correctness gain over middle-state mean
failure_logic.explanations: head-only matching explains staging/refitting; capable single matching explains ordinary augmentation
failure_logic.insufficient: gate diversity/coverage/repaired subset/toy performance or expressivity theorem
